analysis.scope_and_question: The study focused on dengue virus outbreak investigation in Mfandena I Health Area, Cameroon, in 2025, with the central question being to identify evidence of Aedes vectors and evaluate routine surveillance gaps.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A cross-sectional study was conducted in January 2025 (dry season) in Mfandena I Health Area. Cases were identified through healthcare records reviews and community screening, with suspected cases defined by fever >38.5°C lasting 2-7 days and specific symptoms. Immunoglobulin M (IgM) and non-structural protein 1 (NS1) tests were performed, and an entomological survey was conducted within a 1 km radius around case residences.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The investigation confirmed 46 dengue cases (44 suspected, 2 confirmed) and identified Aedes albopictus as the primary vector (88% of collected mosquitoes). A discarded tyre containing Ae. albopictus larvae was identified as the likely infection source. The surveillance system exhibited significant gaps, with only 16% of staff familiar with case definitions and no notification forms available.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The surveillance system was found to be neither simple, acceptable, nor stable, with gaps in detection and reporting. No additional cases were confirmed among contacts, and the study was limited to the dry season, potentially missing seasonal variations in transmission or vector activity.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Strengthening surveillance capacity and reinforcing routine entomological investigations are essential to improve outbreak detection, response, and prevention. The study highlights the need for better staff training on case definitions and improved notification systems.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated a dengue outbreak in Mfandena I Health Area, Cameroon, in 2025, identifying 46 cases and confirming Aedes albopictus as the primary vector. The investigation revealed significant gaps in the surveillance system, including poor staff familiarity with case definitions and lack of notification forms. The findings emphasize the need to strengthen surveillance capacity and routine entomological investigations to improve outbreak detection and response. The study was conducted during the dry season, which may limit the generalizability of findings to other seasons.

abstract_zh: 简介:2024 年 12 月,喀麦隆雅温得姆凡德纳 I 卫生区 (HA) 报告登革热病例突然增加。通报了两例未按常规 监测 进行的确诊病例,但可用数据很少。部署了一个多学科团队来进行积极的病例发现,确定潜在的 媒介 及其幼虫栖息地,并评估登革热 监测 系统。方法:我们于 2025 年 1 月(旱季)在姆凡德纳 I HA 进行了一项横断面研究。病例是通过医疗记录审查和社区筛查发现的。疑似病例是自2024年11月以来居住在Mfandena I HA的人,发烧>38.5°C,持续2-7天,并且至少有以下两种症状:头痛、眼眶后疼痛、肌痛、关节痛、皮疹、出血表现。对同意的疑似病例及其接触者进行了免疫球蛋白M(IgM)和非结构蛋白1(NS1)检测。对病例住所周围1公里半径范围内进行了昆虫学调查。我们遵循 CDC 框架并结合 WHO IDSR 方法进行 监测 系统评估。结果:我们发现了 46 例登革热病例(44 例疑似病例和 02 例确诊病例)和 16 名接触者,但没有确诊其他病例。登革热病例多为21岁以上女性,以发热、关节痛、头痛为主要症状。确诊病例为成年男性:一名居住在喀麦隆,一名来自法国,两人均出现发烧和红斑皮疹症状。在收集的 143 只伊蚊中,Ae.白纹伊蚊占88%(126/143)。我们检测到一个废弃轮胎含有AE。白纹伊蚊幼虫为可能的感染源。监测 系统在检测和报告方面存在缺陷,既不简单、不可接受,也不稳定。只有 16% (4/25) 的工作人员熟悉病例定义,没有站点有通知表,也没有报告过病例。结论:这项调查表明 Mfandena I HA 中存在潜在的登革热 监测,并强调了限制及时检测和报告的重要 监测 差距。加强监测能力和加强常规昆虫学调查对于改进监测检测、应对和预防至关重要。

analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 2025 年 1 月(旱季)在姆凡德纳 I 卫生区进行了一项横断面研究。病例是通过医疗记录审查和社区筛查发现的,疑似病例的定义是发烧>38.5°C,持续2-7天,并有特定症状。进行了免疫球蛋白M(IgM)和非结构蛋白1(NS1)检测,并在病例居住地周围1公里半径内进行了昆虫学调查。

title: XPO1-dependent nuclear export regulates NS3 localization and promotes DENV-2 replication through mitochondrial remodeling and interferon suppression
abstract: Nucleocytoplasmic transport is essential for cellular homeostasis and is frequently exploited by viruses during infection. Although dengue virus (DENV) non-structural protein 3 (NS3) undergoes nuclear trafficking, the role of nuclear export pathways in its localization and in viral replication remains poorly understood. Here, we show that pharmacological inhibition of exportin 1 (XPO1) promotes the accumulation of DENV-2 NS3 in both the nucleus and mitochondria of infected Huh-7 cells. XPO1 inhibition also induces mitochondrial morphological alterations resembling those observed during DENV infection. Moreover, blockade of nuclear export enhances DENV-2 replication in interferon-stimulated cells by reducing type I interferon production, suggesting the establishment of a pro-viral cellular environment. Our findings reveal that XPO1-mediated nuclear export contributes to the regulation of NS3 localization and links nuclear export to mitochondrial remodeling and suppression of antiviral signaling during DENV infection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the role of nuclear export pathways in the localization of DENV-2 NS3 and its impact on viral replication. Dengue virus, which belongs to the flavivirus family, exploits nucleocytoplasmic transport for its replication and pathogenesis.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted using Huh-7 cells infected with DENV-2. Pharmacological inhibition of XPO1 was applied to examine its effects on NS3 localization and viral replication.
analysis.methods: The researchers used pharmacological inhibition of XPO1 to assess its impact on DENV-2 NS3 localization and replication. They observed changes in mitochondrial morphology and interferon production in infected cells.
analysis.main_results: Pharmacological inhibition of XPO1 led to the accumulation of DENV-2 NS3 in both the nucleus and mitochondria of infected Huh-7 cells. It also induced mitochondrial morphological alterations and reduced type I interferon production.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that XPO1-mediated nuclear export plays a critical role in regulating NS3 localization and linking nuclear export to mitochondrial remodeling and suppression of antiviral signaling during DENV infection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into the mechanisms of DENV replication and highlight potential therapeutic targets for antiviral strategies by modulating nuclear export pathways.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro experiments using Huh-7 cells, which may not fully represent in vivo conditions. The evidence is moderate as it is based on pharmacological inhibition and cellular observations.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of XPO1-mediated nuclear export in DENV-2 NS3 localization and viral replication. The researchers found that inhibiting XPO1 leads to NS3 accumulation in the nucleus and mitochondria of infected Huh-7 cells, along with mitochondrial morphological changes and reduced interferon production. These findings suggest that XPO1 contributes to the regulation of NS3 and the suppression of antiviral signaling during DENV infection. The study's results have implications for understanding DENV replication mechanisms and could inform future antiviral strategies. However, the study is limited to in vitro experiments, which may not fully capture in vivo dynamics, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

abstract_zh: 核细胞质运输对于细胞稳态至关重要,并且在感染过程中经常被病毒利用。尽管 登革病毒 (DENV) 非结构蛋白 3 (NS3) 经历核运输,但核输出途径在其定位和病毒复制中的作用仍知之甚少。在这里,我们发现输出蛋白 1 (XPO1) 的药理学抑制可促进受感染 Huh-7 细胞的细胞核和线粒体中 DENV-2 NS3 的积累。XPO1 抑制还会诱导线粒体形态变化,类似于 DENV 感染期间观察到的变化。此外,核输出的阻断通过减少I型干扰素的产生来增强干扰素刺激的细胞中的DENV-2复制,这表明促病毒细胞环境的建立。我们的研究结果表明,XPO1 介导的核输出有助于 NS3 定位的调节,并将核输出与 DENV 感染期间线粒体重塑和 抗病毒药物 信号传导抑制联系起来。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是使用感染 DENV-2 的 Huh-7 细胞进行的。应用 XPO1 的药理学抑制来检查其对 NS3 定位和病毒复制的影响。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员利用 XPO1 的药理学抑制来评估其对 DENV-2 NS3 定位和复制的影响。他们观察到受感染细胞中线粒体形态和干扰素产生的变化。
analysis_zh.main_results: XPO1 的药理学抑制导致 DENV-2 NS3 在受感染 Huh-7 细胞的细胞核和线粒体中积累。它还诱导线粒体形态改变并减少 I 型干扰素的产生。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,在 DENV 感染期间,XPO1 介导的核输出在调节 NS3 定位、将核输出与线粒体重塑和 抗病毒药物 信号抑制联系起来方面发挥着关键作用。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果提供了对 DENV 复制机制的深入了解,并强调了 抗病毒药物 策略通过调节核输出途径的潜在治疗靶点。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于使用 Huh-7 细胞的体外实验,可能无法完全代表体内条件。证据是中等的,因为它是基于药理学抑制和细胞观察。

title: Dengue virus 2 vector competence in heatwave-exposed Aedes aegypti mosquitoes is reduced by 5-methylcytosine RNA disruption
abstract: Extreme weather events can profoundly alter the transmission dynamics of dengue virus (DENV) by its primary vector, Aedes aegypti. Understanding how mosquitoes respond to heat stress and how this affects viral transmission is critical for informing global public health strategies. RNA cytosine methylation is an evolutionarily conserved stress-response mechanism in A. aegypti that links environmental perturbations to shifts in RNA metabolism and gene expression. Here, we show that a 5-day heatwave initiated at the time of DENV2 acquisition increases the lifespan of surviving mosquitoes, thereby extending the window of potential virus transmission. Heatwave-exposed mosquitoes exhibit elevated global 5-methylcytosine RNA (5mC-RNA) levels and suppressed antiviral gene expression, facilitating efficient viral replication. Pharmacological disruption of 5mC-RNA with azacytidine counteracts heatwave-induced increases in transmission potential by enhancing antiviral transcription, reducing DENV2 infection prevalence from 78% to 37%, and restoring mosquito late-life survival to rates comparable to non-stressed controls. This integrative approach reveals an epitranscriptomic mechanism by which climate extreme scenarios like heatwaves can amplify dengue transmission risk, and highlights RNA methylation as a potential target for mitigating DENV transmission.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 极端天气事件可以通过其主要的 媒介 埃及伊蚊,深刻改变 登革病毒 (DENV) 的 传播 动态。了解蚊子如何应对热应激以及它如何影响病毒 传播 对于为全球公共卫生战略提供信息至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究调查了为期 5 天的热浪对感染 DENV2 的埃及伊蚊的影响,检查了寿命、病毒 传播 潜力和 RNA 甲基化水平的变化。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员在获取 DENV2 时将蚊子暴露在热浪中,并测量了整体 5-甲基胞嘧啶 RNA (5mC-RNA) 水平、抗病毒药物 基因表达和病毒复制。使用氮胞苷对 5mC-RNA 进行药理学破坏,以评估其对 传播 潜力的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 暴露于热浪的蚊子表现出整体 5mC-RNA 水平升高并抑制 抗病毒药物 基因表达,促进病毒有效复制。5mC-RNA 的药理学破坏将 DENV2 感染 患病率 从 78% 降低至 37%,并将蚊子的晚年存活率恢复到与非应激对照组相当的水平。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,热浪通过涉及 RNA 甲基化的表观转录组机制放大了登革热 抗病毒药物 风险,RNA 甲基化抑制了 抗病毒药物 反应。这项研究强调 RNA 甲基化是在气候压力下缓解 DENV 传播 的潜在目标。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,针对 RNA 甲基化可能是一种在热浪期间减少登革热 监测 的新策略,为面临极端气候的地区的 监测 和干预计划提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究表明热应激、RNA 甲基化和登革热 传播 之间存在很强的机制联系,但需要进一步的研究来在实地环境中验证这些发现并评估长期生态影响。

title: Serotypes of dengue virus and Kdr mutations (F1534C, S989P, V410L, V1016I, and V1016G) in Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes from the commune of Abomey-Calavi, Southern Benin
abstract: Abstract Dengue is a viral infection transmitted by mosquitoes of the Aedes genus, responsible for millions of cases each year. In Benin, several outbreaks have been reported, particularly in Abomey-Calavi, where the first dengue-related death was recorded in 2019. In the absence of a specific treatment, vector control remains the primary preventive measure. However, the emergence of insecticide resistance, notably through kdr mutations, could compromise its effectiveness. This study aims to identify the dengue virus serotypes circulating in the commune of Abomey-Calavi and to assess the frequency of kdr mutations V410L , V1016G , V1016I , F1534C , and S989P in Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes. Mosquitoes were collected in August 2024 from four arrondissement Togba, Calavi, Akassato, and Godomey through morning and afternoon spraying. After morphological identification, molecular analyses were conducted to detect the viral serotypes and kdr mutations. A total of 218 Aedes mosquitoes were collected, with a predominance of Aedes aegypti (68.8%) compared to Aedes albopictus (31.2%). The overall dengue positivity rate was 23.39% (95% CI: 17.9–29.6). The most frequent serotype was DENV-3 (12.4%), followed by DENV-2 (6.9%), DENV-1 (5%), and DENV-4 (0.09%). Six mosquitoes were co-infected with two serotypes. Kdr mutations were detected in both species, with frequencies of 45% for V1016G , 44% for S989P , 40% for F1534C , 22% for V410L , and 19% for V1016I. Four mosquitoes carried three simultaneous mutations, while twenty-two carried two. These results highlight the active circulation of the dengue virus and the presence of kdr mutations in Aedes mosquitoes in Abomey-Calavi. However, no significant association was observed between dengue infection and kdr mutations, and their distribution was independent of the viral serotype. These findings emphasize the need for regular monitoring of kdr mutations to adapt vector control strategies and limit the spread of dengue.
journal: The Journal of Basic and Applied Zoology

title_zh: 贝宁南部阿波美-卡拉维公社埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊的 登革病毒 和 Kdr 突变 血清型(F1534C、S989P、V410L、V1016I 和 V1016G)
source_body_en: Abstract Dengue is a viral infection transmitted by mosquitoes of the Aedes genus, responsible for millions of cases each year. In Benin, several outbreaks have been reported, particularly in Abomey-Calavi, where the first dengue-related death was recorded in 2019. In the absence of a specific treatment, vector control remains the primary preventive measure. However, the emergence of insecticide resistance, notably through kdr mutations, could compromise its effectiveness. This study aims to identify the dengue virus serotypes circulating in the commune of Abomey-Calavi and to assess the frequency of kdr mutations V410L , V1016G , V1016I , F1534C , and S989P in Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes. Mosquitoes were collected in August 2024 from four arrondissement Togba, Calavi, Akassato, and Godomey through morning and afternoon spraying. After morphological identification, molecular analyses were conducted to detect the viral serotypes and kdr mutations. A total of 218 Aedes mosquitoes were collected, with a predominance of Aedes aegypti (68.8%) compared to Aedes albopictus (31.2%). The overall dengue positivity rate was 23.39% (95% CI: 17.9–29.6). The most frequent serotype was DENV-3 (12.4%), followed by DENV-2 (6.9%), DENV-1 (5%), and DENV-4 (0.09%). Six mosquitoes were co-infected with two serotypes. Kdr mutations were detected in both species, with frequencies of 45% for V1016G , 44% for S989P , 40% for F1534C , 22% for V410L , and 19% for V1016I. Four mosquitoes carried three simultaneous mutations, while twenty-two carried two. These results highlight the active circulation of the dengue virus and the presence of kdr mutations in Aedes mosquitoes in Abomey-Calavi. However, no significant association was observed between dengue infection and kdr mutations, and their distribution was independent of the viral serotype. These findings emphasize the need for regular monitoring of kdr mutations to adapt vector control strategies and limit the spread of dengue.

title: Dengue Fever Unmasking JAK2 Mutation-Related Polycythemia Vera Presenting With Extensive Splanchnic Venous Thrombosis and Hemorrhagic Complications: A Diagnostic and Therapeutic Challenge
abstract: Dengue fever is a common arboviral infection characterized by fever, thrombocytopenia, and hemorrhagic manifestations, whereas thrombotic complications are relatively uncommon. We report a case of severe dengue infection revealing previously undiagnosed JAK2-related polycythemia vera (PV) complicated by extensive splanchnic venous thrombosis. A 58-year-old male patient with a history of diabetes mellitus and hypertension presented with a five-day history of fever, anorexia, and abdominal pain. Initial laboratory investigations demonstrated progressive thrombocytopenia, elevated hemoglobin, and increased hematocrit. During hospitalization, platelet counts continued to decline, and dengue serology returned positive. Computed tomography of the abdomen and pelvis revealed extensive splanchnic venous thrombosis involving the superior mesenteric, splenic, and portal venous systems, along with acute pancreatitis. The patient subsequently developed mucosal bleeding. Further evaluation revealed splenomegaly and a positive JAK2 V617F mutation, confirming underlying polycythemia vera. Due to concurrent bleeding and thrombosis, anticoagulation was initially deferred until hematologic stabilization was achieved. The patient was subsequently treated with anticoagulation and hydroxyurea, resulting in clinical recovery. This case highlights the rare coexistence of hemorrhagic and thrombotic complications in dengue fever and emphasizes the importance of considering underlying myeloproliferative neoplasms in patients presenting with atypical thrombosis, erythrocytosis, or splenomegaly.

title_zh: 登革热 揭示 JAK2 突变 相关真性红细胞增多症,表现为广泛的内脏静脉血栓形成和出血并发症:诊断和治疗挑战
source_body_en: Dengue fever is a common arboviral infection characterized by fever, thrombocytopenia, and hemorrhagic manifestations, whereas thrombotic complications are relatively uncommon. We report a case of severe dengue infection revealing previously undiagnosed JAK2-related polycythemia vera (PV) complicated by extensive splanchnic venous thrombosis. A 58-year-old male patient with a history of diabetes mellitus and hypertension presented with a five-day history of fever, anorexia, and abdominal pain. Initial laboratory investigations demonstrated progressive thrombocytopenia, elevated hemoglobin, and increased hematocrit. During hospitalization, platelet counts continued to decline, and dengue serology returned positive. Computed tomography of the abdomen and pelvis revealed extensive splanchnic venous thrombosis involving the superior mesenteric, splenic, and portal venous systems, along with acute pancreatitis. The patient subsequently developed mucosal bleeding. Further evaluation revealed splenomegaly and a positive JAK2 V617F mutation, confirming underlying polycythemia vera. Due to concurrent bleeding and thrombosis, anticoagulation was initially deferred until hematologic stabilization was achieved. The patient was subsequently treated with anticoagulation and hydroxyurea, resulting in clinical recovery. This case highlights the rare coexistence of hemorrhagic and thrombotic complications in dengue fever and emphasizes the importance of considering underlying myeloproliferative neoplasms in patients presenting with atypical thrombosis, erythrocytosis, or splenomegaly.

title: Dengue fever outbreak in Iran: Urgent warnings and solutions
abstract: Dear Editor, Following the COVID-19 pandemic, dengue fever, one of the most important mosquito-borne viral diseases, has become a serious public health challenge in many countries around the world in recent years. Transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes, this disease is prevalent in tropical and subtropical regions. Iran is also at risk of spreading this disease despite being located in a region with a predominantly arid and semi-arid climate. Recent reports of local cases of dengue fever in Hormozgan province, especially in Bandar Lengeh city, are a wake-up call for the country’s health system. Dengue fever is an emerging threat to public health in Iran that requires urgent and coordinated action. Controlling this disease requires the participation of all sectors of society, including the government, health institutions, and the public. By implementing scientific and sustainable strategies and in coordination with government agencies, Iran can be prevented from becoming an endemic area for dengue fever.

title: Machine learning reveals temperature as a key predictor of dengue risk across Thailand's provinces: A 20-year analysis.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue fever remains a critical public health challenge in Thailand, with transmission dynamics driven by complex interactions between environmental and socioeconomic factors. Understanding these predictive factors is essential for developing robust forecasting systems. METHODS: We developed a machine learning framework to classify spatiotemporal dengue risk and identify key predictive factors across Thailand. We analyzed 20 years of monthly dengue hemorrhagic fever surveillance data (2003-2022) from 77 provinces, integrating 54 environmental, climatic, and socioeconomic features. We benchmarked four candidate classifiers - logistic regression, support vector machines, random forests, and eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) - and selected XGBoost on the basis of performance across six metrics. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) were used to interpret feature contributions. The dataset was stratified into training (2003-2016) and testing periods, with the latter subdivided into pre-COVID-19 (2017-2019), COVID-19 (2020-2021), and post-COVID-19 (2022) phases. RESULTS: The XGBoost model achieved an AUC of 0.80 in pre-pandemic testing and 0.74 across the combined during- and post-pandemic period. Temperature dominated the feature-importance ranking, comprising seven of the top ten features, with non-linear thresholds near 21°C for 1-month lagged minimum temperature and near 32°C for 3-month lagged maximum temperature - values that align with established biological constraints on Aedes aegypti-mediated transmission. Precipitation features contributed minimally to model predictions, while a higher Gross Provincial Product was associated with increased dengue risk, consistent with predominantly urban transmission patterns. Model performance deteriorated significantly during the COVID-19 pandemic (AUC = 0.62 in 2021), with systematic overprediction indicating that non-environmental factors operating outside the model dominated dengue dynamics during this period. CONCLUSIONS: Temperature is the dominant predictor of dengue risk in Thailand, and the thresholds we recover correspond closely to known biological constraints on vector competence. Environmentally driven prediction is reliable under stationary conditions but degrades substantially during periods of major societal disruption, underscoring the need to integrate behavioral and surveillance-coverage indicators alongside environmental predictors when applying such models in real time.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热 仍然是泰国的一项重大公共卫生挑战,传播 动态是由环境和社会经济因素之间复杂的相互作用驱动的。了解这些预测因素对于开发强大的预测系统至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们分析了 77 个省份 20 年来每月的登革出血热 监测 数据(2003-2022 年),整合了 54 个环境、气候和社会经济特征。
elements_zh.methods: 我们开发了一个机器学习框架来对时空登革热风险进行分类并确定整个泰国的关键预测因素,对四个候选分类器进行基准测试并根据六个指标的性能选择 XGBoost。SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) 用于解释特征贡献,数据集分为训练期 (2003-2016) 和测试期,后者又细分为 COVID-19 前、COVID-19 和 COVID-19 后阶段。
elements_zh.main_results: XGBoost模型在疫情前测试中达到0.80的AUC值,在疫情期间和疫情后合并期间为0.74。温度在特征重要性排名中占主导地位,1个月滞后最低温度在21°C附近,3个月滞后最高温度在32°C附近存在非线性阈值,而降水特征贡献最小。模型在COVID-19疫情期间性能显著下降(2021年AUC为0.62),系统性的过度预测表明在此期间非环境因素主导了登革热的动态变化。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 温度是泰国登革热风险的主要预测因素,我们恢复的阈值与 媒介 能力的已知生物限制密切相关。该研究表明,环境驱动的预测在稳定条件下是可靠的,但在重大社会混乱时期会大幅退化。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 环境驱动的预测在静止条件下是可靠的,但在重大社会混乱期间会大幅退化,这强调了在实时应用此类模型时需要将行为和 监测 覆盖指标与环境预测因素结合起来。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为模型性能在 COVID-19 大流行期间显着恶化,表明模型之外的非环境因素主导了这一时期的登革热动态。所提供的证据并未报告超出观察到的性能下降的具体设计限制或偏差。

title: Alignment-free k-mer-guided design of a pan-Orthoflavivirus RT-qPCR assay
abstract: ABSTRACT The co-circulation and rapid expansion of the genus Orthoflavivirus, including dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), West Nile virus (WNV), Yellow fever virus (YFV), and Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV), pose significant global health challenges. Developing inclusive pan-genus molecular diagnostics is hindered by high nucleotide divergence (>25–30%) and the computational limitations of traditional multiple sequence alignment in detecting conserved motifs across large data sets. To overcome these limitations, we developed a systematic alignment-free design pipeline that uses rigorous k-mer analysis and compacted De Bruijn graphs. We analyzed 11,846 RefSeq viral genomes to identify phylogenetically conserved, functionally relevant signatures within the Orthoflavivirus genus as a case study. The pipeline identified a conserved 600 bp region within the non-structural protein 5 gene, facilitating the design of a broad-spectrum TaqMan RT-qPCR assay. Analytical validation demonstrated limits of detection (LODs) of 1–10 copies/μL for DENV1–4, ZIKV, JEV, and YFV, with no cross-reactivity against non-target pathogens; WNV was consistently detected at 1,000 copies/μL in pilot experiments. In a clinical evaluation of archived samples, the assay achieved 97.33% overall accuracy. It demonstrated 100% sensitivity and specificity for DENV serotypes, yielding significantly earlier cycle threshold (Ct) values compared to a standard commercial kit, while ZIKV detection showed 100% specificity with 71.43% sensitivity. This study validates an alignment-free, k-mer-guided strategy for uncovering conserved diagnostic targets in highly variable viral genera, followed by local MSA-assisted primer-probe design. The resulting assay offers a robust tool for broad frontline surveillance, and the computational framework provides a scalable solution for future pandemic preparedness. IMPORTANCE Mosquito-borne viruses like dengue, Zika, and West Nile pose a massive threat to global health. However, because these viruses are highly diverse and mutate rapidly, creating a single diagnostic test to detect all of them has been a challenge. Traditional software struggles to find shared genetic targets across such different viruses. To solve this, we developed a new computational approach. By analyzing over 11,000 viral genomes, we successfully identified a shared genetic signature of a group of mosquito-borne viruses. We used this discovery to create a single, highly accurate test capable of detecting multiple dangerous mosquito-borne viruses at once. This breakthrough provides a crucial, ready-to-use tool for frontline clinical diagnosis and global outbreak surveillance. More importantly, our strategy can be quickly adapted to design broad-spectrum tests for other rapidly mutating viruses, significantly strengthening our ability to prepare for and respond to future pandemics. To solve this, we developed a new computational approach.

source_records.title: Alignment-free k -mer-guided design of a pan- Orthoflavivirus RT-qPCR assay
source_records.abstract: ABSTRACT The co-circulation and rapid expansion of the genus Orthoflavivirus , including dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), West Nile virus (WNV), Yellow fever virus (YFV), and Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV), pose significant global health challenges. Developing inclusive pan-genus molecular diagnostics is hindered by high nucleotide divergence (>25–30%) and the computational limitations of traditional multiple sequence alignment in detecting conserved motifs across large data sets. To overcome these limitations, we developed a systematic alignment-free design pipeline that uses rigorous k -mer analysis and compacted De Bruijn graphs. We analyzed 11,846 RefSeq viral genomes to identify phylogenetically conserved, functionally relevant signatures within the Orthoflavivirus genus as a case study. The pipeline identified a conserved 600 bp region within the non-structural protein 5 gene, facilitating the design of a broad-spectrum TaqMan RT-qPCR assay. Analytical validation demonstrated limits of detection (LODs) of 1–10 copies/μL for DENV1–4, ZIKV, JEV, and YFV, with no cross-reactivity against non-target pathogens; WNV was consistently detected at 1,000 copies/μL in pilot experiments. In a clinical evaluation of archived samples, the assay achieved 97.33% overall accuracy. It demonstrated 100% sensitivity and specificity for DENV serotypes, yielding significantly earlier cycle threshold (Ct) values compared to a standard commercial kit, while ZIKV detection showed 100% specificity with 71.43% sensitivity. This study validates an alignment-free, k -mer-guided strategy for uncovering conserved diagnostic targets in highly variable viral genera, followed by local MSA-assisted primer-probe design. The resulting assay offers a robust tool for broad frontline surveillance, and the computational framework provides a scalable solution for future pandemic preparedness. IMPORTANCE Mosquito-borne viruses like dengue, Zika, and West Nile pose a massive threat to global health. However, because these viruses are highly diverse and mutate rapidly, creating a single diagnostic test to detect all of them has been a challenge. Traditional software struggles to find shared genetic targets across such different viruses. To solve this, we developed a new computational approach. By analyzing over 11,000 viral genomes, we successfully identified a shared genetic signature of a group of mosquito-borne viruses. We used this discovery to create a single, highly accurate test capable of detecting multiple dangerous mosquito-borne viruses at once. This breakthrough provides a crucial, ready-to-use tool for frontline clinical diagnosis and global outbreak surveillance. More importantly, our strategy can be quickly adapted to design broad-spectrum tests for other rapidly mutating viruses, significantly strengthening our ability to prepare for and respond to future pandemics.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the challenges of developing a broad-spectrum diagnostic test for dengue virus and other related flaviviruses due to their high genetic diversity and rapid mutation rates. The co-circulation and expansion of Orthoflavivirus, including dengue virus, Zika virus, West Nile virus, Yellow fever virus, and Japanese encephalitis virus, present significant global health challenges.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved a systematic alignment-free design pipeline using k-mer analysis and De Bruijn graphs to identify conserved genetic signatures within the Orthoflavivirus genus. It included an analytical validation phase and a clinical evaluation of archived samples.
analysis.methods: The pipeline utilized 11,846 RefSeq viral genomes to identify phylogenetically conserved, functionally relevant signatures. It also involved the design of a TaqMan RT-qPCR assay based on these signatures and an analytical validation to assess detection limits and cross-reactivity.
analysis.main_results: Analytical validation showed limits of detection (LODs) of 1–10 copies/μL for DENV1–4, ZIKV, JEV, and YFV, with no cross-reactivity against non-target pathogens. WNV was consistently detected at 1,000 copies/μL in pilot experiments. The assay achieved 97.33% overall accuracy in a clinical evaluation of archived samples.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as demonstrating the effectiveness of an alignment-free, k-mer-guided strategy for identifying conserved diagnostic targets in highly variable viral genera. This approach allows for the design of broad-spectrum diagnostic tools without relying on traditional multiple sequence alignment.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide a robust tool for frontline clinical diagnosis and global outbreak surveillance of dengue virus and related flaviviruses. The strategy can be adapted for other rapidly mutating viruses, enhancing pandemic preparedness.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to abstract-only evidence, which may lack detailed experimental validation. The evidence strength is moderate, as the results are based on analytical validation and clinical evaluation of archived samples without real-time data.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents an alignment-free k-mer-guided design pipeline for a pan-Orthoflavivirus RT-qPCR assay, targeting dengue virus and related flaviviruses. The pipeline uses k-mer analysis and De Bruijn graphs to identify conserved genetic signatures, enabling the development of a broad-spectrum diagnostic test. The assay demonstrated high sensitivity and specificity for dengue serotypes, with limits of detection ranging from 1–10 copies/μL. It also showed no cross-reactivity with non-target pathogens. The study highlights the potential of this approach for improving surveillance and diagnosis of dengue and other rapidly mutating flaviviruses, offering a scalable solution for pandemic preparedness. However, the evidence is based on abstract-only data, which may limit the confidence in the results.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决开发针对 登革病毒 和其他相关黄病毒的广谱诊断测试的挑战,因为它们具有高遗传多样性和快速的 突变 率。正黄病毒(包括 登革病毒、寨卡病毒、西尼罗河病毒、黄热病病毒和日本脑炎病毒)的共同循环和扩张给全球健康带来了重大挑战。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及使用 k-mer 分析和 De Bruijn 图来识别正黄病毒属内保守遗传特征的系统性免比对设计流程。它包括分析验证阶段和对存档样本的临床评估。
elements_zh.methods: 该流程利用 11,846 个 RefSeq 病毒 基因组 来识别系统发育保守、功能相关的特征。它还涉及基于这些特征的 TaqMan RT-qPCR 测定的设计以及评估检测限和交叉反应性的分析验证。
elements_zh.main_results: 分析验证显示 DENV1-4、ZIKV、JEV 和 YFV 的检测限 (LOD) 为 1-10 拷贝/μL,与非目标病原体没有交叉反应。在初步实验中,WNV 的检测浓度始终为 1,000 拷贝/μL。该测定在存档样本的临床评估中总体准确率达到 97.33%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证明了无比对、k-mer 引导策略在高度变异的病毒属中识别保守诊断靶点的有效性。这种方法允许设计广谱诊断工具,而不依赖于传统的多序列比对。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究结果为诊断和登革病毒及相关黄病毒的全球暴发 监测和相关黄病毒的一线临床提供了强大的工具。该策略可以适用于其他快速突变的病毒,从而增强大流行的防范能力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于抽象证据,可能缺乏详细的实验验证。证据强度中等,因为结果基于对存档样本的分析验证和临床评估,没有实时数据。

abstract_zh: 摘要 正黄病毒属的共同传播和快速扩张,包括 登革病毒 (DENV)、寨卡病毒 (ZIKV)、西尼罗河病毒 (WNV)、黄热病病毒 (YFV) 和日本脑炎病毒 (JEV),构成了重大的全球健康挑战。高核苷酸分歧(>25-30%)和传统多序列比对在检测大型数据集中的保守基序时的计算限制阻碍了包容性泛属分子诊断的发展。为了克服这些限制,我们开发了一种系统的免对齐设计流程,该流程使用严格的 k 聚体分析和压缩的 De Bruijn 图。我们分析了 11,846 个 RefSeq 病毒 基因组,以识别正黄病毒属内系统发育保守、功能相关的特征作为案例研究。该管道在非结构蛋白 5 基因内鉴定出一个保守的 600 bp 区域,有助于广谱 TaqMan RT-qPCR 检测的设计。分析验证表明,DENV1-4、ZIKV、JEV 和 YFV 的检测限 (LOD) 为 1-10 个拷贝/μL,且与非目标病原体没有交叉反应;在初步实验中,WNV 的检测浓度始终为 1,000 拷贝/μL。在对存档样本的临床评估中,该检测的总体准确率达到 97.33%。它对 DENV 血清型表现出 100% 的敏感性和特异性,与标准商业试剂盒相比,产生显着更早的循环阈值 (Ct) 值,而 ZIKV 检测显示出 100% 的特异性和 71.43% 的敏感性。这项研究验证了一种免比对、k-mer 引导的策略,用于在高度可变的病毒属中发现保守的诊断靶点,然后进行局部 MSA 辅助的引物探针设计。由此产生的检测为广泛的前线 监测 提供了强大的工具,并且计算框架为未来的大流行防范提供了可扩展的解决方案。重要性 登革热、寨卡病毒和西尼罗河等蚊媒病毒对全球健康构成巨大威胁。然而,由于这些病毒高度多样化且突变迅速,创建单一诊断测试来检测所有病毒一直是一个挑战。传统软件很难在这些不同的病毒中找到共享的基因目标。为了解决这个问题,我们开发了一种新的计算方法。通过分析 11,000 多个病毒 基因组,我们成功识别了一组蚊媒病毒的共同基因特征。我们利用这一发现创建了一种单一的、高度准确的测试,能够同时检测多种危险的蚊媒病毒。这一突破为一线临床 诊断 和全球 暴发 监测 提供了一个关键的、即用型工具。更重要的是,我们的策略可以快速调整,为其他快速变异的病毒设计广谱测试,从而显着增强我们准备和应对未来流行病的能力。为了解决这个问题,我们开发了一种新的计算方法。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究结果为诊断和登革病毒及相关黄病毒的全球暴发 监测和相关黄病毒的一线临床提供了强大的工具。该策略可以适用于其他快速突变的病毒,从而增强大流行的防范能力。

title: Dengue-specific T cell immunity influenced by various levels of pre-existing immunity 2267557
abstract: Abstract Introduction Dengue virus (DENV) is a mosquito-borne flavivirus responsible for significant global morbidity and mortality. Prior exposure to different DENV serotypes can shape subsequent immune responses and influence both protection and risk. This challenges the development of a universally effective and safe dengue vaccine, capable of inducing balanced and durable immunity against all four serotypes. T cells constitute a critical arm of dengue immunity, acting independently of antibodies. In this work, we have evaluated the dengue-specific T-cell responses elicited by an attenuated monovalent DENV3 vaccine in participants with various levels of pre-existing DENV exposure. Methods Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from vaccine recipients of different dengue serostatus (seronegative, monotypic, and multitypic-exposure) were stimulated with experimentally defined DENV3 epitope megapools for DENV structural and nonstructural epitopes. We profiled T cell activation markers, memory phenotypes, and cytokine secretion using a panel of 30+ markers in high-parameter flow cytometry. Results T cells responses were analyzed longitudinally pre-vaccination, and 15, 28 and 90 days after vaccination. The DENV-3 challenge induced measurable DENV-specific T-cell responses for both structural and non-structural components. We observed individual variability in T cell responses that are influenced by their baseline serostatus and viremia burden. Conclusion Our study provides valuable insights into the factors shaping cellular immunity to a novel DENV challenge Funding Source 2P01AI106695-11 Topic Categories Viral Immunology (VIR)

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革病毒 (DENV) 是一种蚊媒黄病毒,导致全球重大发病率和 死亡率。先前接触不同的 DENV 血清型可能会影响随后的 免疫应答 并影响保护和风险。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项研究评估了减毒单价 DENV3 疫苗 在预先存在不同程度 DENV 暴露的参与者中引发的登革热特异性 T 细胞反应。该研究是在对照环境中进行的,疫苗 接受者按血清状态(血清阴性、单型和多型暴露)进行分类。
elements_zh.methods: 使用实验定义的 DENV3 表位大库刺激来自不同登革热血清状态的 疫苗 受体的外周血单核细胞 (PBMC),以获取 DENV 结构和非结构表位。在高参数流式细胞术中使用一组 30 多个标记物对 T 细胞激活标记物、记忆表型和细胞因子分泌进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 疫苗接种 之前以及 疫苗接种 后 15、28 和 90 天纵向分析 T 细胞反应。我们观察到 T 细胞反应的个体差异受到其基线血清状态和病毒血症负担的影响。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 我们的研究为塑造细胞免疫以应对新的 DENV 挑战的因素提供了宝贵的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为开发更有效、更安全的登革热 疫苗 提供信息,该 疫苗 能够诱导针对所有四种血清型的平衡且持久的免疫力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于评估特定 疫苗 背景下的 T 细胞反应,并未涉及更广泛的影响。由于关注单一 疫苗 和有限的群体多样性,证据强度适中。

title: Neutrophil Activation is Associated with Decreased Dengue Vaccine Replication in Human Recipients 2307750
abstract: Abstract Introduction Dengue virus (DENV) is a mosquito-borne flavivirus that impacts over 50% of the global population. A better understanding of DENV-specific immune responses is needed to improve vaccines. Antibody-dependent neutrophil phagocytosis has been associated with protection against hemorrhagic fever, yet excessive neutrophil activation contributes to severe dengue, and the phenotypes of protective neutrophils remain undefined. To characterize how neutrophils respond to DENV, we evaluated neutrophil phenotypes in dengue vaccine recipients and in vitro. Methods 10 participants, with distinct DENV exposure histories, were vaccinated with a monovalent DENV3 vaccine. Cellular neutrophil markers were measured by flow cytometry at baseline (day 0) and on days 1 and 9 post-vaccination. Neutrophils from healthy donors were stimulated in vitro with different DENV serotypes, and their phenotypes were evaluated by flow cytometry. Results Following DENV3 vaccination, the total neutrophil population from all recipients showed elevated SYK and decreased CD33 expression indicating activation and maturation. When compared to participants with high vaccine viremia (N = 7), those with low viremia (N = 3) had increased expressions of CD16 and CD15 and lower CD62L on day 1. Furthermore, low viremic participants had increased CD63 in SYK positive neutrophils on day 9. In-vitro, neutrophils exposed to DENV4 survived up to 96 hours post-stimulation with no evidence of viral infection at various multiplicities of infection (MOI 1-17). Conclusion Neutrophils from participants with low viremia show increased activation, maturation and degranulation supporting their protective role in dengue. Healthy donor neutrophils responding to dengue virus in vitro will be used to characterize how sera from participants with high or low vaccine replication alters neutrophil activity. Overall, a better understanding of neutrophil responses to DENV can inform therapeutic options. Funding Source Intramural Research Program of the National Institutes of Health, NIH Bench-to-Bedside Program Funds No. 994875, NIH Director’s Challenge Innovation Award, ReVAMPP grant 1 U19 AI181960-01, and P01 AI106695. source_body_en: Abstract Introduction Dengue virus (DENV) is a mosquito-borne flavivirus that impacts over 50% of the global population. A better understanding of DENV-specific immune responses is needed to improve vaccines. Antibody-dependent neutrophil phagocytosis has been associated with protection against hemorrhagic fever, yet excessive neutrophil activation contributes to severe dengue, and the phenotypes of protective neutrophils remain undefined. To characterize how neutrophils respond to DENV, we evaluated neutrophil phenotypes in dengue vaccine recipients and in vitro. Methods 10 participants, with distinct DENV exposure histories, were vaccinated with a monovalent DENV3 vaccine. Cellular neutrophil markers were measured by flow cytometry at baseline (day 0) and on days 1 and 9 post-vaccination. Neutrophils from healthy donors were stimulated in vitro with different DENV serotypes, and their phenotypes were evaluated by flow cytometry. Results Following DENV3 vaccination, the total neutrophil population from all recipients showed elevated SYK and decreased CD33 expression indicating activation and maturation. When compared to participants with high vaccine viremia (N = 7), those with low viremia (N = 3) had increased expressions of CD16 and CD15 and lower CD62L on day 1. Furthermore, low viremic participants had increased CD63 in SYK positive neutrophils on day 9. In-vitro, neutrophils exposed to DENV4 survived up to 96 hours post-stimulation with no evidence of viral infection at various multiplicities of infection (MOI 1-17). Conclusion Neutrophils from participants with low viremia show increased activation, maturation and degranulation supporting their protective role in dengue. Healthy donor neutrophils responding to dengue virus in vitro will be used to characterize how sera from participants with high or low vaccine replication alters neutrophil activity. Overall, a better understanding of neutrophil responses to DENV can inform therapeutic options. title: Rapid initiation of standard-volume plasma exchange for acute liver failure from dengue infection.
abstract: The incidence of dengue fever (DF) is rapidly rising and acute liver failure (ALF) is a rare but life-threatening associated complication. We present an adult patient who underwent standard-volume plasma exchange (PLEX) promptly after diagnosis of DF-associated ALF. PLEX of 1.5 times plasma volume was started on the same day of ALF diagnosis with the replacement fluid comprising 2.0 L of fresh frozen plasma and 1.0 L of 5% albumin. The patient's hepatic encephalopathy resolved the following day, and his biochemical profile significantly improved without additional cycles of PLEX and he was discharged well. This case report describes the rapid initiation of PLEX within hours of hepatic encephalopathy onset, using a single cycle of standard-volume PLEX alone without the influence of other therapeutic confounders. This case contributes to the evolving literature on the optimal timing and volume of PLEX in DF-ALF.

title: Development of an NS1-based dengue vaccine that protects via non-neutralizing antibodies and evades antibody-dependent enhancement 2249046
abstract: Abstract Introduction Dengue is a mosquito-borne virus that threatens one half of the global population. While primary infection is usually mild or asymptomatic, secondary infection with another of the four serotypes increases the risk for severe disease due to a phenomenon called antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). Through ADE, non-neutralizing antibodies that target dengue structural proteins facilitate viral entry and replication and worsen disease severity and outcomes. Current dengue vaccines are live-attenuated and do not eliminate the possibility of ADE upon breakthrough infection. Novel vaccines that do not induce ADE are consequently needed. NS1 is a secreted non-structural protein that contributes to dengue pathogenesis by mediating vascular leakage. NS1 is a promising vaccine target because anti-NS1 antibodies are non-neutralizing, thereby evading ADE, and they have also been shown to protect mice from disease. Methods Here, we are developing a DENV2 NS1 mRNA-LNP vaccine that is safe, highly immunogenic, and effective in mice. Results This DENV2 NS1 mRNA-LNP vaccine induces non-neutralizing antibodies that protect against severe disease and mortality in a lethal challenge model. Conclusion In future directions, this work will investigate the mechanisms of non-neutralizing anti-NS1-based protection, including the involvement of affinity maturation and Fc effector functions. Together, we present a promising dengue vaccine strategy that evades ADE and protects against lethal disease. Funding Source Jordan Polster is supported by the HHMI Gilliam Fellows Program. David Martinez is supported by the HHMI Hanna Gray Fellows Program. Topic Categories Vaccines and Immunotherapy (VAC)

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a novel dengue vaccine strategy based on the NS1 protein, which is a secreted non-structural protein involved in dengue pathogenesis. The vaccine, developed as a DENV2 NS1 mRNA-LNP formulation, induces non-neutralizing antibodies that protect against severe disease and mortality in a lethal challenge model in mice. The results offer a promising direction for creating safer and more effective dengue vaccines.

analysis_zh.main_results: 这种 DENV2 NS1 mRNA-LNP 疫苗 诱导非中和抗体,可在致命挑战模型中预防严重疾病和 死亡率。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 因此需要不诱导 ADE 的新型 疫苗。我们共同提出了一种有前途的登革热 疫苗 策略,该策略可以逃避 ADE 并预防致命疾病。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该 疫苗 策略可以通过提供一种逃避 ADE 和预防严重疾病的方法,为未来登革热 疫苗 的发展提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告局限性或证据强度。该研究基于小鼠模型的结果,不包括人体试验或长期随访。

title: A Tetravalent Dengue prM-E mRNA-LNP Vaccine Protects via Antibodies in Susceptible Mice 2255808
abstract: Abstract Introduction Dengue virus (DENV) remains a major global health threat, with no optimal vaccine available against its four distinct serotypes: DENV1, DENV2, DENV3, and DENV4. A central challenge in dengue vaccine development is achieving balanced and durable immunity against all serotypes, as partial protection can lead to antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), increasing the risk of severe disease upon secondary infection. Methods We developed a tetravalent mRNA vaccine encoding the prM-E proteins from each DENV serotype, formulated in lipid nanoparticles (LNPs). The vaccine was administered intramuscularly to C57BL/6J mice. Each dose contained a total of 5 μg mRNA (1.25 μg per serotype) and was given at 4-week intervals for three immunizations. Germinal center (GC) B cell responses and tissue-resident memory T (Trm) cell induction were analyzed in comparison with recombinant Envelope (rE) protein formulated with Alum. Results The tetravalent prM-E mRNA-LNP vaccine elicited strong neutralizing antibody responses against all four serotypes, producing titers of 5481, 4632, 12,179, and 5006 for DENV1-4, respectively. Passive transfer of sera from vaccinated mice conferred complete protection in AG129 mice (IFN-α/β/γR-/-) challenged with lethal DENV2, resulting in 100% survival. By day 14, the prM-E mRNA-LNP group exhibited a two-fold higher frequency of CD38^lowGL7+ GC B cells than the rE + Alum group, indicating enhanced GC B cell activity. Intradermal (ID) vaccination induced significantly higher Trm cell formation in the skin compared to intramuscular delivery, showing approximately four-fold increases following ID prime-boost immunization. Conclusion These findings show that the tetravalent prM-E mRNA-LNP vaccine elicits strong humoral and tissue-resident cellular immunity against all DENV serotypes. The results underscore its robust immunogenicity and protective efficacy, supporting further development of mRNA-based dengue vaccines for broad and durable protection. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革病毒 (DENV) 仍然是一个主要的全球健康威胁,目前还没有针对其四种不同血清型(DENV1、DENV2、DENV3 和 DENV4)的最佳 疫苗。登革热 疫苗 开发的一个核心挑战是实现针对所有血清型的平衡且持久的免疫力,因为部分保护可能导致 抗体依赖性增强 (ADE),增加继发感染时发生严重疾病的风险。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 将编码来自每种 DENV 血清型的 prM-E 蛋白的四价 mRNA 疫苗 配制在脂质纳米颗粒 (LNP) 中,对 C57BL/6J 小鼠进行肌内注射。每剂总共含有 5 μg mRNA(每种血清型 1.25 μg),每 4 周间隔一次,进行 3 次免疫。
elements_zh.methods: 与明矾配制的重组包膜 (rE) 蛋白相比,分析了生发中心 (GC) B 细胞反应和组织驻留记忆 T (Trm) 细胞诱导。还评估了皮内 (ID) 疫苗接种 皮肤中 Trm 细胞的形成。
elements_zh.main_results: 四价 prM-E mRNA-LNP 疫苗 引发针对所有四种血清型的强烈中和抗体反应,产生的 DENV1-4 效价分别为 5481、4632、12,179 和 5006。来自接种疫苗的小鼠的血清被动转移为受到致命 DENV2 攻击的 AG129 小鼠提供了完全保护,导致 100% 存活。到第 14 天,prM-E mRNA-LNP 组表现出的 CD38^lowGL7+ GC B 细胞频率是 rE + Alum 组的两倍,并且与肌内递送相比,ID 疫苗接种 在皮肤中诱导的 Trm 细胞形成大约高四倍。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,四价 prM-E mRNA-LNP 疫苗 能引发针对所有 DENV 血清型的强烈体液和组织驻留细胞免疫。结果强调了其强大的免疫原性和保护功效,支持进一步开发基于 mRNA 的登革热 疫苗,以提供广泛而持久的保护。

title_zh: 四价登革热 prM-E mRNA-LNP 疫苗 通过抗体对易感小鼠提供保护 2255808
source_body_en: Abstract Introduction Dengue virus (DENV) remains a major global health threat, with no optimal vaccine available against its four distinct serotypes: DENV1, DENV2, DENV3, and DENV4. A central challenge in dengue vaccine development is achieving balanced and durable immunity against all serotypes, as partial protection can lead to antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), increasing the risk of severe disease upon secondary infection. Methods We developed a tetravalent mRNA vaccine encoding the prM-E proteins from each DENV serotype, formulated in lipid nanoparticles (LNPs). The vaccine was administered intramuscularly to C57BL/6J mice. Each dose contained a total of 5 μg mRNA (1.25 μg per serotype) and was given at 4-week intervals for three immunizations. Germinal center (GC) B cell responses and tissue-resident memory T (Trm) cell induction were analyzed in comparison with recombinant Envelope (rE) protein formulated with Alum. Results The tetravalent prM-E mRNA-LNP vaccine elicited strong neutralizing antibody responses against all four serotypes, producing titers of 5481, 4632, 12,179, and 5006 for DENV1-4, respectively. Passive transfer of sera from vaccinated mice conferred complete protection in AG129 mice (IFN-α/β/γR-/-) challenged with lethal DENV2, resulting in 100% survival. By day 14, the prM-E mRNA-LNP group exhibited a two-fold higher frequency of CD38^lowGL7+ GC B cells than the rE + Alum group, indicating enhanced GC B cell activity. Intradermal (ID) vaccination induced significantly higher Trm cell formation in the skin compared to intramuscular delivery, showing approximately four-fold increases following ID prime-boost immunization. Conclusion These findings show that the tetravalent prM-E mRNA-LNP vaccine elicits strong humoral and tissue-resident cellular immunity against all DENV serotypes. The results underscore its robust immunogenicity and protective efficacy, supporting further development of mRNA-based dengue vaccines for broad and durable protection. title: I﻿nfrared thermal imaging to determine temperature parameters of dengue vector habitats across ecological regions of Nepal: a pilot feasibility study.
abstract: Dengue is a major vector-borne disease in Nepal, driven by container-breeding Aedes mosquitoes that thrive in domestic, urban settings. Its risk is increasing from the lowland Terai to the Hill and Mountain regions due to urbanisation and global warming. Practical and innovative approaches are needed to better understand the impact on Aedes mosquito habitats that are the main targets for vector control. We conducted a pilot feasibility study to characterise Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus breeding sites, examine physicochemical parameters (total dissolved solids, pH, salinity, dissolved oxygen), and explore the utility of infrared thermal imaging as a novel tool for measuring temperature parameters of habitats across distinct ecological regions. We found that plastic containers, tin/metal items, and rubber tyres were common breeding sites. The dengue vectors Ae. albopictus were identified in a variety of container types across most locations. Overall, there was reasonable agreement between the thermal camera and standard thermometer, although the camera recorded approximately 1 °C lower and showed divergence at higher temperatures. Most aquatic habitat temperatures were within an optimal mosquito breeding range (mid-20s to low 30s °C) and lower than non-breeding site temperatures. The breeding site water temperatures in the Terai region were ~ 4 °C higher than the Mid-Hill and Mountain regions. Aquatic habitat temperatures were also found to be significantly correlated with dissolved oxygen. Thermal imaging case studies provided key visual insights into varying temperatures in complex Aedes microclimates. Notably, inner rubber tyre temperatures remained relatively stable despite significant external temperature fluctuations and external tyre temperatures exceeding 50 °C. Thermal imaging shows promise for the field characterisation of mosquito breeding sites, but it is not interchangeable with standard thermometry without qualification, including calibration and uncertainty analysis.

Its risk is increasing from the lowland Terai to the Hill and Mountain regions due to urbanisation and global warming. We conducted a pilot feasibility study to characterise Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus breeding sites, examine physicochemical parameters (total dissolved solids, pH, salinity, dissolved oxygen), and explore the utility of infrared thermal imaging as a novel tool for measuring temperature parameters of habitats across distinct ecological regions. title: A real-world study on hospital and economic burden of dengue fever in French overseas territories.
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Dengue incidence significantly increased in recent years, representing a public health threat in French overseas territories. Real-world data on its burden is lacking by territory/age groups. OBJECTIVES: To describe the hospital burden and associated costs of dengue in French overseas territories. METHODS: Using the French national hospital database (PMSI), dengue hospitalizations in Martinique, Guadeloupe, French Guiana (FG), and La Réunion were identified over 2017-2024. Hospitalization rates per 100,000 all-cause hospitalizations were calculated overall and during epidemic periods (EPs). Within EPs, patients and stays characteristics and costs were reported. Analyses were conducted by age groups/territories. RESULTS: Over 2017-2024, 8,399 patients were hospitalized, 95.7% during EPs. Hospitalization rates were 2.6 times higher during EPs than overall and were the highest in patients aged 5-19. Hospitalizations mostly involved women and mean age ranged from 28.2 (FG) to 51.3 (La Réunion) years. Mean hospitalization duration ranged from 3.4 (FG) to 5.1 (La Réunion) days, and admissions via emergency room were most frequent in La Réunion (91.8%). Median (Q1-Q3) cost per hospitalization ranged from €1,403 (€846-€2,876) (FG) to €3,385 (€989- €7,119) (La Réunion). CONCLUSIONS: This study highlights the substantial dengue hospital burden, particularly in 5-19-year-old, with variations across French overseas territories. Preventive strategies, including vaccination could reduce this burden.

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This retrospective study used the French national hospital database (PMSI) to identify dengue hospitalizations in Martinique, Guadeloupe, French Guiana, and La Réunion from 2017 to 2024. Analyses were conducted by age groups and territories.

title_zh: 关于法国海外领土 登革热 医院和经济负担的真实世界研究。
source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: Dengue incidence significantly increased in recent years, representing a public health threat in French overseas territories. Real-world data on its burden is lacking by territory/age groups. OBJECTIVES: To describe the hospital burden and associated costs of dengue in French overseas territories. METHODS: Using the French national hospital database (PMSI), dengue hospitalizations in Martinique, Guadeloupe, French Guiana (FG), and La Réunion were identified over 2017-2024. Hospitalization rates per 100,000 all-cause hospitalizations were calculated overall and during epidemic periods (EPs). Within EPs, patients and stays characteristics and costs were reported. Analyses were conducted by age groups/territories. RESULTS: Over 2017-2024, 8,399 patients were hospitalized, 95.7% during EPs. Hospitalization rates were 2.6 times higher during EPs than overall and were the highest in patients aged 5-19. Hospitalizations mostly involved women and mean age ranged from 28.2 (FG) to 51.3 (La Réunion) years. Mean hospitalization duration ranged from 3.4 (FG) to 5.1 (La Réunion) days, and admissions via emergency room were most frequent in La Réunion (91.8%). Median (Q1-Q3) cost per hospitalization ranged from €1,403 (€846-€2,876) (FG) to €3,385 (€989- €7,119) (La Réunion). CONCLUSIONS: This study highlights the substantial dengue hospital burden, particularly in 5-19-year-old, with variations across French overseas territories. Preventive strategies, including vaccination could reduce this burden.

title: Temperature variation as a driver of Wolbachia release efficacy: implications for dengue control in warming climates
abstract: Background Wolbachia-based control methods reduce dengue transmission by suppressing Aedes aegypti populations or blocking viral replication, yet their effectiveness across the climatic conditions of endemic regions remains poorly understood. Seasonal and interannual temperature changes shape mosquito dynamics, but how Wolbachia releases perform during anomalous events such as El Nino or heatwaves is largely unknown a gap that limits our ability to optimize release strategies and predict intervention success across different climates. Methodology/Principal Findings To address this gap, we built a mathematical modeling framework that explicitly incorporates temperature-dependent Wolbachia parameters together with the seasonal and interannual climate variability characteristic of dengue-endemic regions, coupling a detailed Wolbachia dynamics model with a susceptible infectious recovered (SIR) epidemiological model to evaluate Wolbachia establishment, persistence, and stability under different thermal regimes and trace their downstream impact on disease spread. Higher temperatures eroded both Wolbachia establishment and long-term persistence, sharply narrowing the range of effective release strategies as conditions approached 30 C. Seasonality added a further layer of complexity: the timing of thermal stress relative to Wolbachia frequency, not merely its magnitude, determined whether population replacement succeeded. Interannual shifts, progressive warming, widening seasonal swings, and displaced thermal peaks, each eroded Wolbachia prevalence and stability, with effects that compounded over successive years. Dengue transmission tracked these dynamics closely, with warmer conditions producing larger, earlier outbreaks, and intervention success hinging on how release timing, frequency, and targeting were matched to local thermal conditions. Conclusions/Significance As extreme heat events become more frequent under climate change, release programs that ignore local thermal conditions risk falling short where dengue control is most needed. By elucidating the mechanistic interplay among temperature, Wolbachia, and dengue, our findings help refine Wolbachia release programs to suit different climatic conditions, thereby strengthening dengue control as climate variability intensifies.

Methodology/Principal Findings To address this gap, we built a mathematical modeling framework that explicitly incorporates temperature-dependent Wolbachia parameters together with the seasonal and interannual climate variability characteristic of dengue-endemic regions, coupling a detailed Wolbachia dynamics model with a susceptible infectious recovered (SIR) epidemiological model to evaluate Wolbachia establishment, persistence, and stability under different thermal regimes and trace their downstream impact on disease spread. Higher temperatures eroded both Wolbachia establishment and long-term persistence, sharply narrowing the range of effective release strategies as conditions approached 30 C. Seasonality added a further layer of complexity: the timing of thermal stress relative to Wolbachia frequency, not merely its magnitude, determined whether population replacement succeeded. Interannual shifts, progressive warming, widening seasonal swings, and displaced thermal peaks, each eroded Wolbachia prevalence and stability, with effects that compounded over successive years. Dengue transmission tracked these dynamics closely, with warmer conditions producing larger, earlier outbreaks, and intervention success hinging on how release timing, frequency, and targeting were matched to local thermal conditions. Conclusions/Significance As extreme heat events become more frequent under climate change, release programs that ignore local thermal conditions risk falling short where dengue control is most needed. By elucidating the mechanistic interplay among temperature, Wolbachia, and dengue, our findings help refine Wolbachia release programs to suit different climatic conditions, thereby strengthening dengue control as climate variability intensifies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study was needed because the effectiveness of Wolbachia-based dengue control methods across climatic conditions in endemic regions remains poorly understood, particularly during anomalous events like El Nino or heatwaves.

analysis.methods: The methodology involved building a mathematical model that explicitly incorporates temperature-dependent Wolbachia parameters, seasonal and interannual climate variability, and couples Wolbachia dynamics with an SIR epidemiological model to evaluate Wolbachia establishment, persistence, and stability under different thermal regimes.
analysis.main_results: Higher temperatures eroded Wolbachia establishment and long-term persistence, narrowing the range of effective release strategies as conditions approached 30°C; seasonality added complexity as the timing of thermal stress relative to Wolbachia frequency determined population replacement success; interannual shifts, progressive warming, and displaced thermal peaks compounded effects over successive years.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated how temperature variation affects the efficacy of Wolbachia-based dengue control methods using a mathematical modeling framework. The model incorporated temperature-dependent Wolbachia parameters and climate variability to evaluate Wolbachia establishment, persistence, and stability under different thermal regimes. Results showed that higher temperatures eroded Wolbachia effectiveness, seasonality added complexity to release success, and interannual climate shifts compounded negative effects over time. The findings highlight that extreme heat events under climate change may reduce Wolbachia program effectiveness where dengue control is most needed, emphasizing the need to tailor release strategies to local thermal conditions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 这项研究是必要的,因为基于沃尔巴克氏体的登革热控制方法在流行地区的气候条件下的有效性仍然知之甚少,特别是在厄尔尼诺或热浪等异常事件期间。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用了一个数学模型框架,该框架结合了温度依赖性沃尔巴克氏体参数和登革热流行地区的气候变化特征,将沃尔巴克氏体动力学模型与易感感染恢复(SIR)流行病学模型相结合。
elements_zh.methods: 该方法涉及建立一个数学模型,明确地将与温度相关的沃尔巴克氏体参数、季节性和年际气候变化结合起来,并将沃尔巴克氏体动力学与 SIR 流行病学模型结合起来,以评估不同热状况下沃尔巴克氏体的建立、持久性和稳定性。
elements_zh.main_results: 较高的温度会侵蚀沃尔巴克氏体的建立和长期持久性,当条件接近 30°C 时,会缩小有效释放策略的范围;季节性增加了复杂性,因为与沃尔巴克氏体频率相关的热应激时间决定了种群更替的成功;年际变化、逐渐变暖和热峰偏移连续几年加剧了影响。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,气候变化下的极端高温事件可能会降低最需要控制登革热的沃尔巴克氏体释放计划的有效性,而新颖之处在于阐明温度、沃尔巴克氏体和登革热动力学之间的机制相互作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为完善沃尔巴克氏体释放计划以适应不同的气候条件提供信息,从而在气候变化加剧时加强登革热控制,并强调需要将释放时间、频率和目标与当地的热条件相匹配。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究依赖于未经实证验证的数学模型,并且局限性包括缺乏真实世界数据来证实实际气候条件下的模型预测。

abstract_zh: 背景 基于沃尔巴克氏体的控制方法通过抑制埃及伊蚊种群或阻断病毒复制来减少登革热 传播,但其在流行地区气候条件下的有效性仍知之甚少。季节性和年际温度变化影响着蚊子的动态,但沃尔巴克氏体在厄尔尼诺或热浪等异常事件期间的释放情况在很大程度上尚不清楚,这一差距限制了我们优化释放策略和预测不同气候下干预成功的能力。方法/主要发现为了解决这一差距,我们建立了一个数学模型框架,明确地将温度依赖性沃尔巴克氏体参数与登革热流行地区的季节性和年际气候变化特征结合在一起,将详细的沃尔巴克氏体动力学模型与易感感染恢复(SIR)流行病学模型相结合,以评估沃尔巴克氏体在不同热状况下的建立、持久性和稳定性,并追踪其对疾病传播的下游影响。较高的温度会侵蚀沃尔巴克氏体的建立和长期持续性,当条件接近 30°C 时,有效释放策略的范围急剧缩小。季节性又增加了一层复杂性:与沃尔巴克氏体频率相关的热应激时间,而不仅仅是其大小,决定了种群更替是否成功。年际变化、逐渐变暖、季节性波动扩大和热峰移位,每一个都侵蚀着沃尔巴克氏体 患病率 和稳定性,其影响在连续几年中加剧。登革热 传播 密切跟踪这些动态,温暖的条件会产生更大、更早的 暴发,干预的成功取决于释放时间、频率和目标如何与当地的热条件相匹配。结论/意义 随着气候变化导致极端高温事件变得更加频繁,忽视当地高温条件的发布计划可能会在最需要控制登革热的地方出现不足。通过阐明温度、沃尔巴克氏体和登革热之间的机制相互作用,我们的研究结果有助于完善沃尔巴克氏体释放计划以适应不同的气候条件,从而在气候变化加剧时加强登革热控制。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为完善沃尔巴克氏体释放计划以适应不同的气候条件提供信息,从而在气候变化加剧时加强登革热控制,并强调需要将释放时间、频率和目标与当地的热条件相匹配。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究依赖于未经实证验证的数学模型,并且局限性包括缺乏真实世界数据来证实实际气候条件下的模型预测。

title: Pregnant women as a reference population to estimate dengue under-reporting: methodological proposal and application in São Paulo State, Brazil.
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To propose and apply a methodology to estimate the under-reporting of probable dengue cases among non-pregnant women, using the incidence in pregnant women as a reference. METHODS: Ecological study using data on probable dengue cases reported in the state of São Paulo, Brazil, between January and June 2024. Assuming that pregnant women have a higher likelihood of diagnosis and notification due to prenatal follow-up, this group was taken as a reference to calculate the under-reporting of dengue incidence among non-pregnant women aged 18 to 45 years. The association between under-reporting and factors such as Family Health Strategy coverage, number of Primary Health Care Units per thousand women at reproductive age, and degree of urbanization was assessed using logistic regression. Spatial autocorrelation analysis of under-reporting was also performed. RESULTS: Of the 645 municipalities analyzed, 108 (16.7%) showed evidence of under-reporting, ranging from 1% to 95%. It was estimated that 8,624 dengue cases were not detected among non-pregnant women during the study period. No statistically significant associations were found between the analyzed factors and under-reporting. Spatial analysis identified significant clusters of municipalities with underreporting in the northwestern region of the state. CONCLUSION: The proposed methodology may identify areas with probable underreporting and support analyses of determinants of surveillance system sensitivity, thereby helping to guide interventions. Although potentially applicable to other notifiable diseases, comparisons between pregnant and non-pregnant women should be interpreted with caution due to differences in risk, vulnerability, and diagnostic criteria.

elements_zh.main_results: 在分析的 645 个城市中,有 108 个城市 (16.7%) 有证据表明存在少报情况,比例从 1% 到 95% 不等。据估计,研究期间未在非孕妇中发现 8,624 例登革热病例。在分析的因素和漏报之间没有发现统计学上显着的关联。空间分析发现该州西北部地区存在大量漏报城市。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 所提出的方法可以识别可能漏报的领域,并支持对 监测 系统敏感性决定因素的分析,从而帮助指导干预措施。尽管可能适用于其他法定疾病,但由于风险、脆弱性和诊断标准的差异,应谨慎解释孕妇和非孕妇之间的比较。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为漏报率高的地区制定有针对性的 监测 和干预策略提供信息,从而改善登革热病例检测和公共卫生应对措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到其生态设计和孕妇通知率较高的假设的限制,这可能无法完全解释风险和诊断标准的差异。由于研究的设计和解释组间比较时需要谨慎,证据强度中等。

title: Detection of Dengue Virus in Aedes aegypti Mosquitoes, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
abstract: We performed a 1-year mosquito survey in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, after a dengue virus outbreak in 2024. We collected 1,598 Aedes aegypti mosquitoes and detected dengue virus in 5 pools of <20 mosquitoes. Our findings underscore the importance of sustained vector surveillance for dengue virus in arid urban environments.

elements_zh.methods: 该研究收集了 1,598 只埃及伊蚊,并通过合并方法对它们进行 登革病毒 检测。
elements_zh.main_results: 调查期间,在 5 个蚊子数量少于 20 只的蚊子中检测到了 登革病毒。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调需要在城市地区持续实施 媒介 监测 来监测 登革病毒 活动。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果强调了在干旱城市环境中监测 登革病毒 以支持公共卫生干预措施的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于摘要报告,证据基于单一调查,这可能会影响研究结果的普遍性。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the presence of dengue virus in Aedes aegypti mosquitoes following a dengue virus outbreak in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, in 2024.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A 1-year mosquito survey was conducted in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, to collect and analyze Aedes aegypti mosquitoes for dengue virus detection.
analysis_en.methods: The study involved collecting 1,598 Aedes aegypti mosquitoes and testing them for dengue virus through pooling methods.
analysis_en.main_results: Dengue virus was detected in 5 pools of <20 mosquitoes during the survey.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the need for ongoing vector surveillance in urban areas to monitor dengue virus activity.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results emphasize the importance of monitoring dengue virus in arid urban environments to support public health interventions.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to an abstract-only report, and the evidence is based on a single survey, which may affect the generalizability of the findings.

title: Characterization of Non-Neutralizing Antibody Responses in a Dengue Virus-4 Human Challenge Model 2243013
abstract: Abstract Introduction Primary infection with one of the four dengue viruses (DENV-1—4) induces serotype-specific antibodies (Abs) that confer durable protection and cross-reactive Abs that offer transient immunity. While neutralizing Ab titers are commonly used to assess protection, they do not reliably predict disease outcome, and the role of Abs that mediate non-neutralizing effector functions remains poorly understood. We present an approach to evaluate the non-neutralizing Ab (nNAb) response to experimental DENV infection in humans. Methods In a phase 1 open-label study, 14 dengue—naïve subjects were subcutaneously inoculated with a slightly attenuated, live DENV-4 strain, H-241. Plasma was collected from pre- and 6 months post-infection to measure Ab-dependent complement deposition, Ab-dependent cellular phagocytosis, and Ab-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC). All assays used target cells infected with DENV or transfected to express DENV-derived surface-bound NS1 protein. Results Infected subjects generated DENV-4-specific complement-fixing Abs and anti-NS1 Abs that facilitated monocyte-mediated phagocytosis of target cells. DENV-4-specific Abs also mediated NK cell activation in a subset of subjects. Conclusion Future work will focus on extending this functional study to recipients of a tetravalent vaccine followed by DENV-1 challenge to investigate how nNAbs correlate with disease protection/risk, and broaden our understanding of immune defense against dengue beyond neutralizing Abs. Funding Source DOD Topic Categories Viral Immunology (VIR)

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the role of non-neutralizing antibodies (nNAbs) in dengue virus infection, as neutralizing antibody titers do not reliably predict disease outcomes, and the function of nNAbs remains poorly understood.
analysis.study_design_and_population: In a phase 1 open-label study, 14 dengue-naïve subjects were subcutaneously inoculated with a slightly attenuated, live DENV-4 strain, H-241.
analysis.methods: Plasma was collected from pre- and 6 months post-infection to measure Ab-dependent complement deposition, Ab-dependent cellular phagocytosis, and Ab-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC), using target cells infected with DENV or transfected to express DENV-derived surface-bound NS1 protein.
analysis.main_results: Infected subjects generated DENV-4-specific complement-fixing Abs and anti-NS1 Abs that facilitated monocyte-mediated phagocytosis of target cells, and DENV-4-specific Abs also mediated NK cell activation in a subset of subjects.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors demonstrated that non-neutralizing antibodies play a role in immune responses to DENV-4 infection, providing new insights into immune defense beyond neutralizing antibodies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform future research on how nNAbs correlate with disease protection or risk, potentially improving vaccine development and understanding of dengue immunity.

analysis.summary_en: This study characterized non-neutralizing antibody responses in a DENV-4 human challenge model. In a phase 1 open-label study, 14 dengue-naïve subjects were inoculated with a live attenuated DENV-4 strain. Plasma was analyzed for Ab-dependent complement deposition, phagocytosis, and cytotoxicity using DENV-infected or NS1-expressing target cells. Results showed DENV-4-specific complement-fixing Abs, anti-NS1 Abs facilitating monocyte phagocytosis, and NK cell activation in some subjects. The study highlights the role of nNAbs in dengue immunity, with future work planned to extend findings to tetravalent vaccine recipients. The evidence strength is moderate, limited by sample size and single-serotype focus.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估非中和抗体 (nNAb) 在 登革病毒 感染中的作用,因为中和抗体滴度不能可靠地预测疾病结果,而且 nNAb 的功能仍然知之甚少。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在一项1期开放标签研究中,14名登革病毒无感染史受试者接受了皮下接种,接种物为一种轻度减毒的活登革病毒4型毒株H-241。
elements_zh.methods: 使用感染 DENV 或转染表达 DENV 衍生的表面结合 NS1 蛋白的靶细胞,从感染前和感染后 6 个月收集血浆,以测量 Ab 依赖性补体沉积、Ab 依赖性细胞吞噬作用和 Ab 依赖性细胞毒性 (ADCC)。
elements_zh.main_results: 受感染的受试者产生 DENV-4 特异性补体固定抗体和抗 NS1 抗体,促进单核细胞介导的靶细胞吞噬作用,并且 DENV-4 特异性抗体还在受试者亚群中介导 NK 细胞活化。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者证明,非中和抗体在 免疫应答 至 DENV-4 感染中发挥作用,为除中和抗体之外的免疫防御提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为未来关于 nNAb 如何与疾病保护或风险相关的研究提供了信息,可能会改善 疫苗 的开发和对登革热免疫的理解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量较小且只关注单一血清型的限制,但使用功能性抗体反应的直接测量提供了中等的证据强度。

Methods In a phase 1 open-label study, 14 dengue—naïve subjects were subcutaneously inoculated with a slightly attenuated, live DENV-4 strain, H-241. Plasma was collected from pre- and 6 months post-infection to measure Ab-dependent complement deposition, Ab-dependent cellular phagocytosis, and Ab-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC). All assays used target cells infected with DENV or transfected to express DENV-derived surface-bound NS1 protein. Results Infected subjects generated DENV-4-specific complement-fixing Abs and anti-NS1 Abs that facilitated monocyte-mediated phagocytosis of target cells. DENV-4-specific Abs also mediated NK cell activation in a subset of subjects. Conclusion Future work will focus on extending this functional study to recipients of a tetravalent vaccine followed by DENV-1 challenge to investigate how nNAbs correlate with disease protection/risk, and broaden our understanding of immune defense against dengue beyond neutralizing Abs. title: Unmanaged plastic waste significantly increases dengue burden
abstract: Abstract Plastic pollution is increasingly recognized as a global environmental challenge, yet its role as a measurable driver of infectious disease risk remains poorly quantified. We developed a material-specific extension of the WHO-recommended Breteau Index (BI) that incorporated discarded waste into routine Aedes larval surveillance and evaluated its ability to explain dengue risk using nationwide surveillance data from Sri Lanka. We found that discarded non-biodegradable waste represented a major breeding habitat associated with dengue transmission, with plastic containers comprising the dominant material fraction. Waste-associated breeding habitats accounted for 30–34% of reported dengue burden nationally during 2024–2025. An empirically derived material-partitioning approach further estimated that plastic-associated habitats contributed approximately 22–23% of dengue burden across sentinel districts. Together, this material-specific surveillance framework translates unmanaged environmental waste into measurable infectious disease risk, providing a practical indicator instrument for both downstream vector surveillance and upstream waste-management and plastic policies.

title: Molecular detection of Coxiella burnetii in suspected dengue patients from the Bauru region, São Paulo State, Brazil.
abstract: Q fever, caused by Coxiella burnetii, is an underdiagnosed zoonosis in Brazil due to its non-specific clinical presentation and limited diagnostic capacity. This study investigated the molecular detection of C. burnetii in serum samples from patients with acute febrile illness initially suspected of dengue in 34 municipalities of São Paulo State, Brazil. A total of 300 serum samples collected over a three-year period from patients with suspected dengue fever were analyzed. Only samples obtained from patients presenting with up to seven days of febrile illness were included. All samples tested negative for dengue, leptospirosis, and brucellosis and were analyzed by real-time PCR targeting the IS1111 gene. burnetii DNA was detected in 1.3% (4/300) of the samples (95%CI: 0.37%-3.35%), compatible with recent infection during the early symptomatic phase. This study represents the second report of molecular detection of C. burnetii in patients with acute febrile syndrome in Brazil and the first one in São Paulo State. Previous serological studies indicate widespread exposure to the pathogen, highlighting the complementary roles of molecular and serological approaches. These findings support the inclusion of Q fever in the differential diagnosis of undifferentiated febrile illnesses and suggest that One Health-oriented surveillance strategies may help reduce underdiagnosis in Brazil, although further studies with larger sample sizes are needed to confirm this recommendation.

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据因其侧重于特定地理区域的分子检测和相对较小的样本量而受到限制,这可能会影响普遍性。这些发现的可信度是中等的。

abstract_zh: 由伯内特立克克斯体引起的 Q 热在巴西是一种诊断不足的 人兽共患病,因为其临床表现非特异性且诊断能力有限。本研究调查了巴西圣保罗州 34 个城市最初怀疑患有登革热的急性发热性疾病患者血清样本中伯内特念珠菌的分子检测。对三年内从疑似 登革热 患者收集的总共 300 份血清样本进行了分析。仅包括从发烧长达 7 天的患者获得的样本。所有样本的登革热、钩端螺旋体病和布鲁氏菌病检测均为阴性,并通过针对 IS1111 基因的实时 PCR 进行分析。在 1.3% (4/300) 的样本中检测到伯内特氏菌 DNA (95%CI: 0.37%-3.35%),这与早期症状阶段的近期感染相符。这项研究是巴西急性发热综合征患者中伯内特念珠菌分子检测的第二份报告,也是圣保罗州的第一份报告。先前的血清学研究表明广泛接触病原体,强调了分子和血清学方法的互补作用。这些发现支持将 Q 热纳入未分化发热性疾病的鉴别诊断 诊断 中,并表明以单一健康为导向的 监测 策略可能有助于减少巴西的漏诊率,尽管需要更大样本量的进一步研究来证实这一建议。

title: Correlation of NS1 Antigen and Dengue Virus Serotype with Infection Status in Dengue Patients
abstract: Non-structural protein 1 (NS1) antigen is an important biomarker for the early diagnosis of dengue virus infection. However, NS1 detection may be influenced by dengue virus serotype and the host immune response during primary and secondary infections, with inconsistent findings reported across previous studies. To investigate the association between NS1 antigen positivity, dengue virus serotypes, and infection status in patients with RT-PCR-confirmed dengue infection. An analytical cross-sectional study was conducted among 65 hospitalized patients with RT-PCR-confirmed dengue infection. Blood samples were collected within the first five days after fever onset (median, 3 days; range, 1–5 days). Dengue virus serotypes were identified using the STANDARD M10 Arbovirus Panel, while infection status was determined using the STANDARD F Dengue IgM/IgG fluorescence immunoassay. Associations between NS1 antigen positivity, dengue virus serotypes, and infection status were analyzed using Fisher's exact test. Among 65 RT-PCR-confirmed cases, 55 (84.6%) were NS1-positive, and 10 (15.4%) were NS1-negative. Serotype distribution was DENV-1 (36.9%), DENV-2 (21.5%), DENV-3 (29.2%), DENV-4 (9.2%), and mixed DENV-2/DENV-3 infection (3.1%). No significant associations were found between NS1 antigen positivity and dengue virus serotypes (p = 0.969) or infection status (p = 0.456). Although NS1 positivity was higher in primary than secondary infections (86.4% vs. 66.7%), the difference was not statistically significant. NS1 antigen positivity was not significantly associated with dengue virus serotypes or infection status. The high NS1 positivity observed in this study may reflect early specimen collection during the acute phase of illness, regardless of infection status or viral serotype.
